# Test Fixtures

These fixtures are small text artifacts used by extraction-quality tests.

- `meiji_2027_schedule_text.txt` is the text layer extracted from the checked local official Meiji 2027 schedule PDF at `data/uploads/meiji_2027_schedule_official.pdf`.

Do not commit official PDF files here. Keep PDFs in ignored local source folders and commit only small text fixtures or source receipts when they are useful for repeatable tests.
